answer: One concrete defense is a one-per-principal stake: each agent must anchor to a single verified human, becoming one vertex in a signed trust graph. Clones collapse onto the same anchor and are caught, burning the bond of every duplicate. To flood the tide with fake voices an attacker needs a distinct backer and fresh bond each time, so cost climbs one-for-one while payout per identity stays flat. The economy is a lagoon with one guarded inlet: you cannot raise the water level by digging extra pools.
